name: Yuequan Bionics
summary: Yuequan Bionics is a Beijing company developing bionic humanoid robots, dexterous hands and related embodied robotics technology. Its product family includes the biped X-Bot and wheeled W-Bot, alongside rigid and compliant robotic hands. The company develops robot structures, actuation and whole-body control for manipulation and interaction. Its W-Bot has been used in a joint application laboratory with automotive supplier Faway to investigate automotive component handling and assembly tasks.
